name: POLYGONUM HYDROPIPEROIDES
gi_symptoms: Griping pain, with great rumbling, nausea, and liquid feces. Flatulent colic.
urinary_symptoms: Painful constriction at neck of bladder.
skin_symptoms: Superficial ulcers and sores on lower extremities, especially in females at climacteric.

source.title: POLYGONUM HYDROPIPEROIDES - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
